name: Mister Bee Potato Chips Co
old_description: Since 1951 Mister Bee has been making the finest potato chips from simple ingredients right here in the Mountain State. Our potato chips are made from real whole fresh potatoes. We pick our potatoes based on flavor not looks so no two chips are exactly alike. We leave the skins on and cook them lower and slower than the big chip companies because perfection takes time. The result is a true blast from the past.
about:
Mister Bee Potato Chips Co. has operated from Parkersburg, West Virginia, since its founding in 1951. The company began as a regional snack maker focused on producing potato chips from whole fresh potatoes, though the names of its original founders are not publicly documented.

The company manufactures kettle-style potato chips using a low-and-slow cooking method that leaves the potato skins on. Potatoes are selected for flavor rather than appearance, resulting in chips that vary in shape and color. The process emphasizes simple ingredients and a slower fry time compared to large-scale commercial producers.

Mister Bee serves the snack food market, distributing its chips through retail and wholesale channels. The brand positions itself as a heritage snack made in the Mountain State, appealing to consumers seeking a traditional potato chip experience.

The company differentiates itself by cooking chips at lower temperatures for longer periods, a practice it says preserves flavor and texture. Its marketing highlights the use of whole potatoes with skins intact and a selection process based on taste rather than visual uniformity.
